description: Full CRUD over the signed-in user's personal Outlook contacts (destructive: covers `delete` action). action=`list` (default) returns contacts with pagination via `skip`/`count` (default 50). action=`search` returns contacts matching `query` against name/email (default 25). action=`get` returns full contact detail by `id`. action=`create` adds a new contact and returns its `id`. action=`update` patches the given fields by `id` (only fields passed are changed). action=`delete` removes the contact by `id`; it skips Deleted Items, so treat it as permanent and pass `dryRun: true` first to confirm which contact it is. Use `outputVerbosity` (minimal/standard/full) on list/search to control field count. Searches only your personal contact store; for relevance-ranked search across contacts, the directory and recent communications, use `search-people`.

count.description: Number of results (action=list default: 50, action=search default: 25)

dryRun.description: Preview only (action=delete): nothing is deleted. Shows which contact would be removed. Other actions refuse dryRun and change nothing. Default false.

emails.description: Multiple email addresses (action=create/update). First entry is primary.

firstName.description: Given name (action=create/update). Maps to Graph `givenName`. If displayName not provided, will be combined with lastName.

query.description: Search query for name or email (action=search, required)

skip.description: Pagination offset for action=list (default: 0). Use the value suggested by the previous page response.

name: manage-contact
title: Contacts
